extraction.document_summary: Singlife CareShield Standard and Singlife CareShield Plus are government-approved CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement plans by Singlife (Singapore Life Ltd. underwrites). They pay additional support for severe disability on top of the national schemes’ severe disability payouts. The key difference is the disability trigger: Standard pays when you cannot perform at least three of six ADLs, while Plus requires at least two ADLs and can be set to increasing payouts (2% or 3% annually for Plus, versus fixed for Standard). Both plans include extra monthlies beyond the base severe-disability monthly payout (Add-on Benefit for up to 12 months), and provide lump-sum relief when severe disability occurs, plus family-oriented benefits tied to a child below age 22 and caregiver relief. A 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits, and MediSave usage is limited to S$600 per calendar year per life assured.
quality_notes: Document clearly distinguishes Singlife CareShield Standard vs Singlife CareShield Plus and states key ADL thresholds, payout structures, and several benefit types.
No specific entry-age ranges, coverage duration end ages, or detailed underwriting rules are stated in the provided text.
Exact premium amounts are not provided; only payment-period options and MediSave limits are stated.

policies.quick_summary: CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that pays additional monthly benefits for severe disability (unable to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs), with a fixed payout option, plus add-on, lump-sum, and family/caregiver benefits. A 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits, and MediSave use is capped at S$600 per calendar year per life assured. Premiums may be payable up to a specified time (including up to age 98) or for a limited period (with limited-time options described). Additional increases of monthly benefit may be possible without underwriting hassle but are limited to 50% of initial monthly benefit.
policies.target_customer: People who already have a CareShield Life (CSHL) policy or an ElderShield (ESH) policy and want to buy government-approved supplement coverage.
coverage_scope: Additional monthly payout for severe disability on top of CareShield Life/ElderShield
Add-on monthly payout for up to 12 months
Lump-sum benefit when severely disabled (and other benefit-linked payouts including dependant care and caregiver relief)
Death payout equal to three times the plan’s monthly benefit (or rehabilitation benefit) under stated conditions
Waiver of premium relief when mild disability is met (unable to perform at least 1 ADL)
policies.eligibility_notes: You need to have a CareShield Life (CSHL) or ElderShield (ESH) policy before you purchase Singlife CareShield Standard.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: You can choose a premium payment period: pay up to the policy anniversary after you turn 98, or pay for a limited time. For limited time, the brochure states two ways: (a) pay up to the policy anniversary after they turn 68, or (b) pay for 20 years from entry age if joining at age 49 or older (the later of the two applies).
important_caveats: Severe disability definition differs by plan: for Standard it requires inability to perform at least three of the six ADLs.

The brochure states a 90-day Deferment Period from confirmation/certification by an Appointed Assessor as severely disabled; monthly benefit, Lump Sum Benefit, Dependant Care Benefit and Caregiver Relief Benefit are paid after the Deferment Period.
Waiver of Premium is applicable after the Deferment Period.
MediSave can be used up to S$600 per calendar year per life assured; premiums exceeding this limit must be paid in cash.
